Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Why did the British Empire end after WWII?
options: The UN forced Britain to grant independence to all colonies in 1945.
William was Edward the Confessor's eldest son.
Britain voluntarily gave its colonies independence as a moral choice.
Britain was bankrupted by the war, faced rising nationalist movements, and confronted US/Soviet pressure against colonialism in a new world order.

mcqs.q: Why was Vesalius significant in the history of medicine?
options: His 1543 De Humani Corporis Fabrica corrected Galen's errors via human dissection and accurate illustration, founding modern anatomy though not curing disease.
The UN forced Britain to grant independence to all colonies in 1945.
Vesalius invented the microscope.
Vesalius discovered the cause of disease and ended humoral theory.
